items.title: Home
items.desc: A quick summary of your farm: this week's harvest total, pending pick-ups, your active pick-up, and a shortcut to add a new harvest.

items.title: Harvest
items.desc: Every harvest you've recorded, with its status. Edit or delete the ones that haven't been picked up yet.

items.desc: Select harvests that are ready and send a pick-up request to the distributor, and track requests you've already sent.

items.title: Profile
items.desc: Your account details, language setting, this guide, and support contact.
On Home or the Harvest tab, tap "Add harvest vegetables."
Type the vegetable name and enter the quantity you harvested, in kilograms.
Choose a status — Available if it's ready to be picked up, or Reserved if you're holding it back for now.
Tap Save. The harvest date is recorded automatically — you don't need to set it yourself.
Go to the Pick-up tab.
Tap Select on each harvest you want the distributor to collect.
Tap Review to see everything you've selected, then tap Request pick-up.
Each harvest's status changes to Pending pick-up, and it appears in your pick-up tracking list.

items.title: Picked Up
items.desc: Your harvest has been collected — this pick-up is complete.
You can only edit or delete a harvest while it's Available or Reserved. Once it's Pending pick-up or Picked Up, it's locked.
Adding or editing a harvest works even without internet — it saves on your phone and is sent automatically once you’re back online. Requesting a pick-up needs an internet connection.
Only real vegetables can be added — other items aren't accepted.
VeggieTrack has one central distributor, so every pick-up request goes to the same warehouse.

sections.heading: How to Approve a Pick-up Request

items.desc: From Home, open Pickup Requests under Quick Actions.
Find the farmer's request and tap Approve & Assign.
Optionally set a price per kg now, or leave it blank and set it later when you list the batch.
Choose an available rider and confirm. The request becomes Assigned and the rider is notified.

sections.heading: How to List Produce for Sale

items.desc: Go to the Stocks tab and open the Batches view.
Once a rider marks a harvest Picked Up, it appears here as a new batch.
Make sure the batch has a photo — tap Edit to add one if it's missing.
Tap Add to Product List, confirm the price per kg, and it becomes visible to retailers.

sections.heading: How to Process a Retailer Order

items.desc: Open the Orders tab — new orders appear under Pending.
Tap Approve to accept it, or Reject and give a reason to decline it — this automatically returns the stock to your inventory.
Once approved, choose an available rider and tap Assign Delivery.
Track its progress under Approved, or view completed orders under History.

items.title: Delivered

VeggieTrack has only one distributor account — you're the single central warehouse for every farmer and retailer.
A batch needs a photo before it can be listed. To remove or replace the photo, unlist it first.
Rejecting or cancelling a pending order automatically restores that stock to your inventory — no manual adjustment needed.
Once a rider is assigned to an order, it can't be handed to someone else — you'd need the retailer or system to reset it first.

items.title: Profile
items.desc: Your account details, saved addresses, language setting, this guide, and support contact.
On Home, tap a product to see details, or use the quick + button to add it straight to your cart.
Go to Cart and check your items and quantities — your order must total at least 5 kg.
Tap Place Order, then choose a saved delivery address (or add a new one) and a delivery date and time.
Tap Confirm Order. You'll see a confirmation, and the order appears under Orders as Pending.
Open the Orders tab and find your order.
Once the distributor approves it and assigns a rider, tap Track Order to see the live route on the map.
Tap View Details any time to see the full item list, delivery info, and current status.
Once delivered, look for the proof-of-delivery photo attached to that order.

Orders are filled oldest-stock-first (FIFO), so you always receive the freshest available batches first.
Minimum order size is 5 kg in total.
Your delivery address needs a pinned map location — set this in Manage Address before checking out.
You can only cancel an order while it's still Pending.
Delivered orders move to your Order History after 5 days.

sections.heading: How to Complete a Farmer Pick-up

items.desc: Open Tasks and switch to Pickups.
Tap Start Pickup to let the farmer know you're on your way (optional — you can skip straight to the next step).
When you arrive and collect the harvest, tap Mark Picked Up.
Take or choose a photo, then tap Confirm. Your location is saved automatically, and the harvest is added to the distributor’s stock.

sections.heading: How to Complete a Retailer Delivery

items.desc: Open Tasks and switch to Deliveries, or tap Navigate on an assigned order for turn-by-turn directions.
Tap View Details, then move the order forward step by step: Picked Up, then In Transit.
Once you've arrived, tap Mark Delivered.
Take or choose a proof photo — your location is checked against the delivery address — then tap Confirm to complete it.

items.title: Assigned
items.desc: Waiting for you to start.

items.title: On the Way / In Transit
items.desc: You've started heading to the pick-up or delivery.

items.title: Picked Up
items.desc: You've collected the harvest from the farmer.

items.title: Completed / Delivered
items.desc: The task is finished and recorded.

items.title: Cancelled
items.desc: The task was cancelled and is no longer yours.
You can only reject a delivery before you've started it, while it's still Assigned.
You can't mark an order Delivered until you've moved it through Picked Up and In Transit first.
Completing a pick-up or delivery always needs a photo and your location — make sure location access is turned on.
If your location isn’t clear enough, you’ll be asked to wait a moment and try again before confirming.

faqs.q: What is the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) system?
faqs.a: VeggieTrack automatically sorts available crops by their harvest dates (oldest first). This encourages retailers to buy older stock first, reducing food spoilage and waste.

faqs.q: What happens when I have no internet?
faqs.a: Farmers can record harvests even without internet. Your entries are saved on your phone and sent automatically once you’re back online.

faqs.q: What happens if an order is cancelled?
faqs.a: When a retailer cancels an unapproved order, the product stock is immediately restored back to the distributor's available inventory.

faqs.q: Why can there only be one Distributor account?
faqs.a: VeggieTrack connects farmers, one distributor and retailers. The distributor’s warehouse receives vegetables from many farmers and supplies many retailers.
Once a distributor approves a retailer order and assigns a rider, the Retailer can click "Track Delivery" to view route pins on an embedded map.
